p.src: Store of value. Money lets people move purchasing power over time, though inflation weakens this function.

u.src: Store of value. Money lets people move purchasing power over time, though inflation weakens this function.

p.src: In ordinary life, the money people use most is not paper currency. It is bank deposits. This is why public debates about money often go wrong: people imagine cash, while modern economies mainly transact with digitally recorded bank liabilities.
